symbols.name: digit width
symbols.meaning: The number of bits in one digit, so that digits are taken in radix $2^b$.
symbols.quote: Let $b$ be the number of bits in one digit.

symbols.name: digits per input
symbols.meaning: The number of radix-$2^b$ digits in each input.
symbols.quote: Let $m$ be the number of digits in each input.

symbols.name: first input
symbols.meaning: The first of the two integers being multiplied.
symbols.quote: Let $u$ be the first input and $v$ the second.

symbols.name: second input
symbols.meaning: The second of the two integers being multiplied.
symbols.quote: Let $u$ be the first input and $v$ the second.

relations.quote: Multiplication reduces to [Cyclic convolution](cyclic-convolution.md) of short integer coefficients, once the digit sequences are padded with zeros to length at least $2m-1$, which keeps the cyclic wrap-around from mixing terms.
